title:
Represents keyspace (Database) for the Cassandra Datastore. Note its Nameable which means that the name of the keyspace
is locally unique to the cluster. It is also DefaultInstance i.e. there is a default keyspace in the default cluster
for the given application
@see Cassandra.Cluster
name: Cassandra.Keyspace
